query:
WITH holding AS (
                    -- Holding a worker, by the same test the fairness refresh counts with: a
                    -- live runtime ping, and not a flow job, which stays running between steps
                    -- without a worker.
                    SELECT DISTINCT q.workspace_id FROM v2_job_queue q
                    JOIN v2_job j ON j.id = q.id
                    JOIN v2_job_runtime r ON r.id = q.id
                    WHERE q.tag = $1 AND q.running = true AND q.suspend_until IS NULL
                      AND q.workspace_id = ANY($3::text[])
                      AND r.ping > NOW() - interval '60 seconds'
                      AND j.kind NOT IN ('flow', 'flowpreview', 'flownode', 'singlestepflow')
                ), waiting AS (
                    SELECT q.workspace_id, q.scheduled_for, h.workspace_id IS NOT NULL AS excluded
                    FROM v2_job_queue q LEFT JOIN holding h USING (workspace_id)
                    WHERE q.tag = $1
                      AND q.scheduled_for <= NOW() - $2::interval
                      AND q.running = false
                )
                SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT excluded) as count,
                       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE excluded) as excluded_count,
                       MIN(scheduled_for) FILTER (WHERE NOT excluded) as oldest_job,
                       array_agg(DISTINCT workspace_id) FILTER (WHERE excluded) as excluded_workspaces
                FROM waiting
